How well each approach (list: decision_approaches, membership_options, conflict_management) suits each community type (community_types.json). Marks from −2 (strongly against) to +2 (strongly for); a blank means no opinion. flag "gate": generally not a fit for this community type (no chip; the reason is shown). flag "interesting": rare for this community type but viable (not penalised; its reason says so). status: proposed until reviewed. Identity / cultural and DAO / web3 are blank for now. Review changes: "change" is "added" or "changed" (with "was": the mark before) since the first draft; "removed" lists marks taken out. Approving a setting (scripts/review.mjs) clears them.
